payload.text: hv, 23 Oct 2026, to vc, answering vc's question on the checks before 2.14.2's cut: "Dry run, then cut (Recommended)". vc's reading. (1) dc's final-head gate phases do not run for 2.14.2. CI's own green on b3374e73, on every job in push 39859337814 and dispatch 39859347138, stands as the twin of every CI job: main's code is b3374e73's, and everything past it is under intent/, which no CI job or test reads. (2) dc runs the release dry run, bin/devbin release --patch --dry-run, in the primary, alone on a quiet host. Every node is frozen from vc's GO until vc says the cut's last row is read. (3) Then hv's cut from hv's terminal: bin/devbin release --patch. (4) Any change outside intent/ before the cut voids (1), and the gate's phases run. (5) ic's hold 14, the gate's menuz-app phase, does not run.
